text_block_list.text: During training with Biwa Hayahide, she seemed unusually preoccupied with her hands.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No, it's nothing serious.
I've just run out of hand cream at the moment.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I chose it carefully based on its ingredients to suit my skin, but it seems to be out of stock right now.
Perhaps that's why my hands have been feeling a bit rough...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
choice_data_list: Shall we look for a hand cream that suits you?
Shall we look for a hand cream that suits you?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Wha--!? I-It's fine! They'll
probably restock before long, anyway...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Um... In order to check the condition, I'd have to show you my chapped hands, wouldn't I...?

It seems Biwa Hayahide
is troubled by skin breakouts...
